name: Incline Fly Press (Dumbbell)
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your upper chest.
Open your arms in a fly until you feel a chest stretch.
As you come back, bend your elbows and press the dumbbells up and together.
Lock out with the dumbbells over your chest.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: An incline dumbbell fly that transitions into a press to work the upper chest.
